'''0.24a''' is a major update for [[Survarium]] that added the [[charging stations]] [[Teamplay]] mode, [[Vector Laboratory]] and [[Cologne Bridge]] locations and introduced the [[Camouflage & decals#Decals|decals]] system.

==Changelog==
===Gameplay===
* Added [[Vector Laboratory|“Vector” Laboratory]] location
* Added [[Cologne Bridge]] location
* Changed the rules of the PVP mode for new locations. Now the batteries are not scattered throughout the level but appear after a random amount of time in special charging stations
* Added decals that allows players to customize the appearance of their characters
* Added new quest types from factions
* Now the first three victories in a day will give you twice the experience and reputation. When running a series of seven days with three victories, you'll get [[Gold]]
* Reduced the probability of finding items after a match the level of which is higher than your current level of battle
* Now all the items found after a match will be in poor condition with critical malfunctions
* Factions loyalty mechanics removed from the game
* Increased the amount of money and reputation that a player receives for good performance in matches;
* Significantly reduced efficiency of skills: characteristics growth at maximum level is +5-10%, high-level players do not have too big advantages over the low-level ones now
* Reduced energy cost of sprint, characters can now run longer

===Equipment and armament===
* Increased cost of weapons by 20%
* Increased cost of pants by 20%
* Reduced cost of gloves and boots by 10%
* Armor-piercing of [[TT-33]] and the [[PPSH-41]] was increased from 10 to 20
* Reduced values of movement speed modifiers from 2/4/6/8/10 to 1/2/3/4/5
* Reduced values of damage modifiers from 2/4/6/8/10 to 1/2/3/4/5
* Reduced values of armor modifiers from 2/4/6/8/10 to 2/3/4/5/8
* Reduced values of recoil modifiers from 5/10/15/20/25 to 2/4/6/8/10
* Reduced values of stamina cost modifiers from 5/10/15/20/25 to 2/4/6/8/10
* Reduced values of stamina regeneration modifiers from 5/10/15/20/25 to 2/4/6/8/10
* Reduced values of dispersion modifiers from 5/10/15/20/25 to 2/4/6/8/10
* Reduced values of fire rate modifiers from 5/10/12/15/20 to 2/4/6/8/10
* Reduced values of reload speed, weight, aiming speed from 5/10/15/20/25 to 5/8/10/12/15
* Added new ammo 5.45õ39 7N10, +10% to armor-piercing
* Added smoke grenades [[RGD-M]]

===Scavengers===
* [[TOZ-34]]: damage increased from 80 to 100
* [[MP-153]]: reduced rate of fire

===Black Market===
* [[TOZ-66]]: damage increased from 85 to 100
* [[Remington 870]]: damage reduced from 115 to 110
* [[AKS-74U]]: damage increased from 43 to 48

===Fringe Settlers===
* Added new armor sets: "Leshy" and "Keeper"
* Added new weapons: “[[Vepr]]” and [[RPK-74M]]
* [[Benelli M4 Super 90]]: moved to 7th level of equipment, damage reduced from 125 to 110, reduced rate of fire and shot distance
* Stalker armor set, Explorer armor set and [[SV-98]] moved to 7th level of equipment
* "Emerald" gas mask armor increased to 20
* [[APS]] rate of fire reduced to 40
* [[SKS]]: damage reduced to 65, dispersion reduced to 1

===Renaissance Army===
* Added new armor sets: “Molot UM-2", "OZK-18KB"
* Added new weapons: [[AK-74M]], [[A-545]]
* [[Franchi SPAS 12]]: moved to 7th level of equipment, damage decreased from 135 to 110, reduced rate of fire and shot distance
* "Assault" armor set, Scout armor set and RPD moved to 7th level of equipment
* Scout’s boots weight reduced to 1 kg

===User Interface===
* Expanded information that is displayed to the user when log in error occurs

===Bug Fixes===
* Optimized RAM use, improved stability on x86 systems or systems with small amount of RAM
* Fixed error that led to a crash, when items were put in quick-slots in a certain way
* Fixed synchronization error that under certain conditions lead to a crash
* Limited maximum number of connections when distributing the game client to other players
